scientific_integrity: An analytic proof is supplied for all dimensions in scope; a reproducible exact rational two-node calculation and finite numerical experiments are supplements only. Originality is provisional against uninspected historical full text; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires fixed symmetric strictly positive-definite doubly stochastic mixing matrix with simple unit eigenvalue, common positive step and scalar strongly convex quadratic costs. The theorem is not a numerical finite-precision robustness bound, a rate optimum, or an extension to negative eigenvalues of the mixing matrix.
title: A sharp generalized-eigenvalue step-size threshold for positive-spectrum gradient tracking
